::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1865]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. Printed in Romanes, <i>[Appreciation](other_books/otherbook_241.qmd)</i> p. 93
:::

We have just finished [Dr. Livingstone](people/person_1935.qmd), noble man that he is; all that one can wish is that he knew what the Church meant.[^1] The grand simplicity of his courage and endurance is most magnificent. I am sure England has not come to degeneracy yet.

---

[^1]: The explorer and missionary Dr. David Livingstone (1813-1873) was a Congregationalist, which would account for CMY’s regret.  She and her mother had no doubt been reading his *Narrative of an expedition to the Zambesi and its tributaries and of the discovery of the lakes Shirwa and Nyassa, 1858-1864* (1865).
